news.analysis: Burrow had another unreal performance on Sunday night. He took on a tough Pittsburgh defense, but he was able to come away with over 400 yards and four touchdowns en route to a win, while also committing zero turnovers in the process. He has been playing some of the best football in the league recently and will certainly be an MVP finalist if he can continue on a similar pace over the back half of the season.
news.contents: Joe Burrow completed 35-of-44 passing attempts for 409 yards and four touchdowns in Sunday night's 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.title: Joe Burrow dominant in win Sunday

news.contents: Cincinnati Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow completed 35 of his 44 pass attempts for 409 yards, four passing touchdowns, and zero turnovers during Sunday's Week 10 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers. He also rushed for eight yards and took just one sack. Burrow has been absolutely magnificent lately, becoming just the second player in NFL history to record 4+ touchdowns in five consecutive games. news.analysis: Pollard ended Sunday's game one yard shy of 100 yards on the day. His 66 receiving yards were the second-most on the team, and his eight catches led the team. Tyjae Spears had more efficiency on his four rushing attempts, but played clear second fiddle to Pollard. Keep Pollard in lineups as a volume RB3 with RB2 upside, especially if the Titans keep up their newfound energy.
